systemArchitectures.name: Commercial Continuous Supercritical CO2 Foam Mat Drying & In-Line Porosimetry (SFM-DIP) Industrial Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Continuous Aseptic Supercritical Foam Generation & Low-Temperature Dehydration Skid (FDA 21 CFR § 117 FSMA cGMP / 3-A Sanitary Standards 63-04 & 08-17 / EHEDG Type EL Class I CIP / ASME Section VIII Div 1 & ASME B31.3 Process Piping)
systemArchitectures.technology: Continuous high-pressure supercritical CO2 micro-dosing and dissolution (80 – 160 bar, 35 – 42 °C) into viscous food hydrocolloid purees, followed by controlled slit-die nozzle pressure drop producing a micro-cellular foam mat (porosity ε > 90%, cell size 15 – 45 µm, open-cell ratio >92%). Coupled with non-destructive in-line ultrasonic acoustic porosimetry (400 kHz) and sub-10 minute low-temperature convective drying (32 – 40 °C), achieving water activity a_w < 0.25 with >97.5% vitamin C retention and >92% probiotic viability.
systemArchitectures.cipSanitizationRating: 100% Resistant to 2.0% NaOH at 80°C, 1.5% PAA at 50°C, EHEDG Type EL Class I

foamMatFormulations.name: Strawberry & Lactobacillus acidophilus Probiotic Puree Foam
foamMatFormulations.formulationDescription: High-viscosity organic strawberry puree blended with 0.8% citrus pectin and live probiotic Lactobacillus acidophilus strain LA-5 (10^9 CFU/g).
foamMatFormulations.degradingAlternative: Rotary Drum Drying (130°C causing complete destruction of probiotic cultures, 68% vitamin C degradation, and dark burnt off-flavor)

foamMatFormulations.name: Alphonso Mango & Acacia Gum Prebiotic Fiber Foam Mat

foamMatFormulations.degradingAlternative: Hot-Air Tray Cabinet Drying (70°C for 8 hours leading to severe case hardening, glassy shrinkage, and 52% beta-carotene loss)

foamMatFormulations.name: Wild Açaí Berry & Pea Protein Antioxidant Crisp Matrix

foamMatFormulations.name: Cultured Greek Yogurt & Bifidobacterium Bio-Active Crisp

foamMatFormulations.name: Organic Spirulina & C-Phycocyanin Bio-Matrix Foam

foamMatFormulations.name: Subcritical Depressurization & Foam Cell Collapse Hazard Mode
foamMatFormulations.formulationDescription: Hazard baseline simulation: insufficient dissolution pressure (P < 73.8 bar), sub-critical CO2 liquid slugs, and premature bubble coalescence leading to foam collapse.
foamMatFormulations.degradingAlternative: Catastrophic foam drainage, structural crusting, mold growth hazard (a_w > 0.55), and ASME B31.3 two-phase liquid slugging risk
